entries.description: Reads the joystick switches (DX=0000h) or the stick positions (DX=0001h).

entries.name: wait
entries.description: Waits for the number of microseconds in CX:DX.

entries.name: copy extended memory
entries.description: Copies CX words between linear addresses through a GDT at ES:SI, reaching memory above 1 MB.

entries.differs: The list says the standard BIOS reports only memory between 1 MB and 16 MB; the emulator reports the whole CMOS value.

entries.name: switch to protected
entries.description: Reprograms the PICs and switches the CPU to protected mode with a caller-supplied GDT at ES:SI.
entries.behaviour: Writes BH to the master PIC and BL to the slave as vector bases, masks all IRQs, enables A20, loads the GDT and IDT from ES:SI+08h and +10h, sets CR0.PE, loads DS=18h, ES=20h, SS=28h, then pops the return IP, adds 6 to SP, clears the flags, sets AX=0000h and jumps to CS=30h.
